results.headline: JPMorgan Q3 Net Income Rises 35% on Higher Interest Income
results.body: JPMorgan Chase reported Q3 2024 net income of $12.9 billion, up 35% from a year earlier, driven by rising net interest income and strong investment banking fees. Revenue of $43.3 billion beat analyst expectations of $41.8 billion. CEO Jamie Dimon warned of geopolitical risks and potential credit deterioration ahead.

results.headline: Exxon Q3 Earnings Beat on Pioneer Synergies; OPEC Uncertainty Clouds Q4 Outlook
results.body: Exxon Mobil reported Q3 earnings of $1.92 per share, beating estimates of $1.88. The Pioneer Natural Resources acquisition added $500 million in synergies ahead of schedule. However, executives cautioned that the OPEC+ production policy uncertainty and global demand softness could weigh on Q4 results. The company maintained its $35 billion share buyback program.

results.headline: Nvidia Data Center Revenue Hits Record $22.6B in Q3 FY2025, Surpassing Analyst Expectations
results.body: Nvidia reported record data center revenue of $22.6 billion for Q3 FY2025, up 112% year-over-year. The result exceeded Wall Street consensus of $21.1 billion. CEO Jensen Huang cited explosive demand for H100 and H200 GPUs from hyperscalers and cloud providers. The company guided Q4 data center revenue above $37 billion.
